articles.title: UP Man Booked for Offering Namaz in Temple—But He's Lived There for 25 Years
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Badaun, Uttar Pradesh – An FIR has been registered against a man named Ali Mohammad for offering namaz within the premises of the Brahmadev temple.

body.html:
Badaun, Uttar Pradesh – An FIR has been registered against a man named Ali Mohammad for offering namaz within the premises of the Brahmadev temple. However, police investigations revealed that Ali has been living at the temple for the past 25–30 years, regularly cleaning the premises and feeding cows.

The incident has sparked debate over religious harmony and intent, with locals vouching for Ali’s service to the temple over decades. Authorities are reviewing the matter in light of these findings.

body.html:
Firozpur, Punjab – A local cricket match turned tragic in Guru Har Sahai after a player, Harjit Singh, collapsed and died moments after hitting a six. The incident, which occurred at the DAV School ground, was caught on camera and has gone viral on social media.

Harjit, a carpenter by profession, is seen resting after the shot before suddenly falling to the ground. Teammates attempted CPR, but he died before medical help arrived. Preliminary reports suggest cardiac arrest as the cause.

articles.excerpt: Firozabad, Uttar Pradesh – In a shocking display of public recklessness, a couple was caught on video romancing on a moving bike around 10 PM on the Agra–Kanpur National Highway.

body.html:
Firozabad, Uttar Pradesh – In a shocking display of public recklessness, a couple was caught on video romancing on a moving bike around 10 PM on the Agra–Kanpur National Highway. The woman lay stretched out on the fuel tank, while the man, without a helmet, drove fearlessly through traffic. The video, recorded by a passerby, has since gone viral.

When confronted, the biker rudely told the onlooker to "mind his own business." The act not only violated traffic norms but also risked lives. Firozabad Police responded to the viral clip, stating that legal action is underway.

Social media erupted with criticism. Users slammed the couple’s behaviour, calling it vulgar and dangerous, and demanded strict police action. Many compared it to a similar recent incident in Noida, where a couple was fined ₹53,500 for a similar act.

articles.title: UP Forest Inspector Attacks Journalists with Stick, Defies DM
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Muzaffarnagar – Forest Inspector Aditya Sharma was caught on camera misbehaving with journalists who had arrived to take a byte regarding illegal felling of Khair trees worth crores.

body.html:
Muzaffarnagar – Forest Inspector Aditya Sharma was caught on camera misbehaving with journalists who had arrived to take a byte regarding illegal felling of Khair trees worth crores. Instead of responding, Sharma ran after media personnel with a stick, openly threatening them and even dismissing the District Magistrate, saying, “Go tell this to the DM also.”

The journalists were reporting on massive corruption in the Forest Department involving stolen timber and forest mafia collusion. The video of the incident has gone viral, drawing public outrage.

articles.excerpt: Ghaziabad – In Khoda, just 20 km from Delhi, residents are fighting daily battles—not for land or money, but for water. With the groundwater level plunging to 1000 feet and a ban on new submersibles, municipal tankers remain the only source of water, leading to chaos every day.

body.html:
Ghaziabad – In Khoda, just 20 km from Delhi, residents are fighting daily battles—not for land or money, but for water. With the groundwater level plunging to 1000 feet and a ban on new submersibles, municipal tankers remain the only source of water, leading to chaos every day.

For the last 10 years, pipeline-based water supply has existed only on paper. Frustrated by the crisis, many families have abandoned their homes in search of a livable future elsewhere. Despite promises, the situation remains unchanged.

articles.title: Sunroof Romance on Chandigarh-Manali Highway Goes Viral—Couple Fined ₹4,000 for Public PDA!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Himachal Pradesh – A video of a young couple kissing and hugging through the sunroof of a moving car on the Chandigarh-Manali four-lane highway has gone viral, sparking public outrage.

body.html:
Himachal Pradesh – A video of a young couple kissing and hugging through the sunroof of a moving car on the Chandigarh-Manali four-lane highway has gone viral, sparking public outrage. The car, registered in Haryana’s Guhla village, was recorded by a passerby, with the clip now circulating widely on social media.

The couple’s public display of affection (PDA) led to a fine of ₹4,000. As per Section 294 of the IPC, acts considered “obscene” and causing public annoyance can be penalised. Netizens have compared the incident to similar recent controversies, including a viral video involving a BJP MLA.

Earlier on June 22, another video showed a group of tourists partying and drinking in a moving car, for which they were fined ₹2,500.

As his family rushed outside for safety, the boy briefly joined them—only to dash back inside to grab food from the dining table.

body.html:
Guangdong, China – A young boy from Qingyuan has gone viral after CCTV footage showed his unexpected reaction during a 4.3-magnitude earthquake on June 23. As his family rushed outside for safety, the boy briefly joined them—only to dash back inside to grab food from the dining table.

The video shows the father and two sons having a meal when tremors began. While the younger son and father quickly exited, the elder boy returned to stuff food into his mouth, even attempting to carry a bowl. His act has amused netizens, sparking memes and jokes online.

articles.title: Tragedy in the Ring: Wrestler Dies Mid-Bout During Dangal Final in J&K—Shocking Video Goes Viral!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Kathua, J&K – In a tragic turn of events, wrestler Sonu from Jalandhar died after collapsing during the final match of an annual Dangal competition in the Dinga Amb area of Kathua district. The bout was against Rinku from Delhi.

body.html:
Kathua, J&K – In a tragic turn of events, wrestler Sonu from Jalandhar died after collapsing during the final match of an annual Dangal competition in the Dinga Amb area of Kathua district. The bout was against Rinku from Delhi.

A viral video shows the match at an intense stage when Sonu suddenly fell unconscious. Spectators were stunned when he didn’t respond. He was rushed to Hiranagar Hospital, where doctors declared him dead on arrival.

Organisers halted the event as mourning spread across the venue. Sonu was reportedly fit and trained regularly. Police have launched an investigation, and the body has been sent for postmortem.

articles.title: Teacher-Student Love Ends in Murder & Suicide: Rajasthan’s Shocking Live-In Tragedy!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Jaipur – A tragic twist has emerged in the Sahdev Bhakar murder case in Rajasthan’s Nagaur. Karishma Chaudhary, his live-in partner, was found dead by suicide on Tuesday morning at Sahdev’s home.

body.html:
Jaipur – A tragic twist has emerged in the Sahdev Bhakar murder case in Rajasthan’s Nagaur. Karishma Chaudhary, his live-in partner, was found dead by suicide on Tuesday morning at Sahdev’s home. The case had already drawn attention after Karishma accused her own family of murdering Sahdev in what she called an honour killing.

Karishma, a nursing student from Dharana village, had fallen in love with her college teacher, Sahdev, while still a minor. Sahdev, who was already married, filed for divorce after Karishma turned 18. The two entered a live-in relationship and moved across several cities.

In June, Karishma alleged that her family abducted and killed Sahdev. Despite reporting threats and requesting protection, no police security was provided. Now, Karishma’s death has raised serious questions about police inaction and the role of her family.
